snippet.title: Castle Doombad Classic - Gameplay Trailer 2026
snippet.description:
Castle Doombad is the treacherous Tower Defense puzzler where you play the villain and must defend against the pesky heroes invading your evil lair! Get ready to Break Bad and play TODAY on either Steam (PC, MAC) or mobile (iOS, Android)! Visit https://www.castledoombad.com now to download.

Created by Grumpyface Studios, Castle Doombad was originally released in 2014, previously published by Adult Swim Games. The current available version is "Castle Doombad Classic" on Steam, which includes the complete original game remastered and with new content and features. "Castle Doombad: Free to Slay" is the Free to Play version of Classic, available for mobile.
